The '''Tatooine Dash''' was a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] used by the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] to decrease the travel [[Time/Legends|time]] between [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and its important holdings in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Astrography==
The Tatooine Dash began at [[Nar Kaaga/Legends|Nar Kaaga]], passed through the [[Manda system/Legends|Manda system]], and ended at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="LoNH" /> It intersected the [[Kaaga Run/Legends|Kaaga Run]] at Nar Kaaga, the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]] and the [[Manda-Roon Merchant Route]] at [[Manda/Legends|Manda]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="GatORW" /> and the [[Corellian Skip Run]], [[The Crystal Passage/Legends|the Crystal Passage]], the [[Old Corellian Run]] and the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] at Tatooine.<ref name="LoNH" /><ref name="TEA" />
